en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a medieval wall fresco. The painting shows a hilly landscape with groups of peasants in short tunics working the fields with hoes and sickles, and others in a boat on a river below. On the left are fortified buildings or a small walled town; on the right is an ornate vertical architectural frame with decorative patterns, part of the interior wall where the fresco is located. At the top center a radiant sun with a face and short rays is painted, flanked by small texts on either side. The lower part of the postcard is blank, as if reserved for caption or message.
